'''Eero Iridian's father''' was a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. A member of a [[Eero Iridian's species|species]] with flexible antennae, he ran down his family's finances during his term, such that following his retirement, his son, [[Eero Iridian]], was unable to successfully run for senator.
